title: Three-pullback reassociation with an arbitrary common-stage arrow
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l in Type (u+1), and a scheme X in Type u on which l is invertible. Use the actual common-stage constructible category and pullback P_f of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the specified compositor c(f,g)_K:P_(f≫g)K→P_f(P_g K) of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. For arbitrary endomorphisms f,g,h of X, common-stage objects K,L, and an arbitrary rational common-stage morphism t:P_h K→L, the composite c(f,g≫h)_K ≫ P_f(c(g,h)_K) ≫ P_f(P_g(t)) is heterogeneously equal to c(f≫g,h)_K ≫ P_(f≫g)(t) ≫ c(f,g)_L. The source types are identified by associativity f≫(g≫h)=(f≫g)≫h. No Weil structure or invariant integral lattice is assumed.

proof.text: The chosen integral family c of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition] satisfies c(f,g≫h) followed by P_f(c(g,h)) = c(f≫g,h) followed by c(f,g) at P_h K, after source associativity. Its naturality for t gives c(f,g) at P_h K followed by P_f(P_g(t)) = P_(f≫g)(t) followed by c(f,g) at L. Compose these two equations. At a rational finite stage localPullbackComposition is the localization of this family conjugated by localPullbackObjectIso. The normalized rational pullback action on pure tensors carries the integral equation to rational pure tensors; additivity proves the equation for arbitrary rational t. Object comparisons cancel in both words.

Represent t at a finite coefficient field containing the endpoint stages. The commonStageDerivedPullback representative formula conjugates its rational pullback by commonStagePullbackComparison. The specified scalar comparisons commute with compositor maps: at finite coefficient quotients both paths are the same associativity of inverse image and scalar tensor, and the coherent system comparisons preserve that equality before inverse limit. Thus the representative of composition defined at K.stage equals the rational compositor at the chosen common stage, conjugated by those comparisons. Substitute these representatives into both words; cancel adjacent inverse comparisons and apply the rational equation from step 1. Inclusion of the resulting equal representatives in the Hom colimit proves the desired heterogeneous equality.

theorem composition_map_assoc (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (f g h : X ⟶ X)
    (K L : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X)
    (t : (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω h).obj K ⟶ L) :
    HEq
      ((composition l Ω f (g ≫ h) K).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).map (composition l Ω g h K).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).map
          ((commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω g).map t))
      ((composition l Ω (f ≫ g) h K).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω (f ≫ g)).map t ≫
        (composition l Ω f g L).hom)
